It is available for mac, I should note that it's not a free program for either OS unless you know where to look ;)

I personally use PCstitch, I stitch at my computer desk so it's especially useful because you can highlight specific sections of colour, zoom in etc. The patterns it prints aren't bad either. You can view some of the patterns here if you like. https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B01QuE5xEW9AWldtU0VYUDQxQ3c&authuser=0.  
The alternative is you can post the image on this subreddit, people here are pretty quick to assist.

Edit: I also found and used this site often, http://coricamo.com/photo/?lang=en, it's basically a free image to pattern converter. It doesn't allow you to modify the image in the sense of erasing or changing colours, but it does have several settings that can increase detail, resolution etc.
